output.title: BR-04 each converted line is rounded half away from zero in the invoice currency before tax, and the totals add up the rounded lines @critical
output.data_choice: P-1130 is the only free project billed in a foreign currency with taxed time lines: USD at 1.0835, tax code S at 25.5%. On its own the seeded lines convert to almost exact amounts. So a +18.00 EUR write-up on line 3 makes 270.00 EUR convert to exactly 292.545 USD. Rounding the line half away from zero gives 292.55 and a subtotal of 2,632.91. The defect's code left the line unrounded and rounded only the total with Math.Round, whose default rounds half to even, giving 2,632.90. The defect would therefore show again on this data.
scenario: Create a proposal for projects.polarReporting with period end PERIOD_END and the invoice date left at the period end
Write up line 3 by 18 EUR with the reason 'Extra report review agreed with customer'
Read the currency, the exchange rate and the line count
Read line 3's date, adjustment, amount and tax, and the amounts of lines 1 and 2
Read the subtotal, the tax and the total
Accept the confirmation dialog and delete the proposal
